福爾摩沙小導遊臺南 Tainan・大臺南

烏山頭水庫與八田與一Wushantou Reservoir & Hatta Yoichi

歡迎來到烏山頭水庫。從空中看，它像一株綠珊瑚，所以人們叫它珊瑚潭。水庫建成之前，嘉南平原是一場賭局：旱季龜裂、雨季氾濫，還有鹽分毒害。水庫建於 1920 到 1930 年，是嘉南大圳的心臟；大壩是夯土造的，不是混凝土。一萬六千公里的圳路把水送出去，稻米、甘蔗和蔬菜隨之而來。總工程師八田與一的銅像，席地而坐，正在思考。每一碗台南米，都從這裡開始。

Welcome to Wushantou Reservoir. From the air it looks like green coral, so people call it Coral Lake. Before the reservoir, the Chianan Plain was a gamble: fields cracked in drought, drowned in flood, and were poisoned by salt. Built between 1920 and 1930, the reservoir is the heart of the Chianan Irrigation System. Its dam is packed earth, not concrete. Sixteen thousand kilometers of canals carried the water, and rice, sugarcane and vegetables followed. The chief engineer, Yoichi Hatta, is remembered with a statue that sits on the ground, thinking. Every bowl of Tainan rice started here. Let's start exploring!

為什麼值得來

Why it matters & history

烏山頭水庫是嘉南大圳的心臟。水庫完成後，一萬六千公里的圳路把水送遍嘉南平原，把旱澇交替的土地變成台灣的穀倉。總工程師八田與一的銅像，至今坐在湖邊沉思。

Wushantou Reservoir is the heart of the Chianan Canal. Once it was built, sixteen thousand kilometers of channels carried water across the plain and turned it into Taiwan's rice bowl. The statue of chief engineer Hatta Yoichi still sits by the lake.

  1. 1920–1930興建水庫，大壩以夯土築成。The reservoir is built with an earth-fill dam.
  2. 1930 後 After 1930嘉南大圳通水，稻米、甘蔗和蔬菜隨之而來。Water flows through the canal network, and rice, sugarcane and vegetables follow.
  3. 每年 Every year5 月 8 日，人們在銅像前紀念八田與一。On 8 May each year, people gather at the statue to remember Hatta.

認識景點

About the place

水庫：烏山頭水庫的形狀像一株綠珊瑚。 珊瑚潭：數十條被淹沒的山谷，形成珊瑚潭的形狀。 水壩：大壩是一座夯土造的溫柔巨人，不是混凝土。 灌溉：是透過圳路把水送到田裡。

reservoir: Wushantou Reservoir is shaped like green coral. Coral Lake: Dozens of drowned valleys make the shape of Coral Lake. dam: The dam is a gentle giant of packed earth, not concrete. irrigation: Irrigation brings water to the fields through canals.

圳、渠道：一萬六千公里的圳路把水送遍整個平原。 乾旱：時，田地龜裂。 淹水：雨季時，田地被大水淹沒。 鹽分地：土裡的鹽分毒害作物。

canal: Sixteen thousand kilometers of canals carry the water across the plain. drought: In a drought, the fields cracked. flood: In the rainy season, the fields drowned in floods. salty soil: Salt in the soil poisoned the crops.

輪灌：是讓各區田地輪流分配用水。 飯碗：這潭水把乾渴的平原變成台灣的飯碗。 甘蔗：水來了以後，稻米、甘蔗和蔬菜跟著長出來。 雨豆樹：湖邊有一條著名的南洋雨豆樹大道。

rotation irrigation: Rotation irrigation shares the water among the fields in turn. rice bowl: The water turned a thirsty plain into Taiwan's rice bowl. sugarcane: Rice, sugarcane and vegetables grew after the water came. rain tree: A famous avenue of South American rain trees grows by the lake.

遊湖船：只有搭船在水上，才感覺得到珊瑚的形狀。 工程師：八田與一是嘉南大圳的總工程師。 銅像：他的銅像穿著工作服席地而坐，手托下巴，正在思考。 日式木屋：四棟日式木屋重現了當年的工程師宿舍村。

boat cruise: Only from a boat can you feel the coral shape of the lake. engineer: Yoichi Hatta was the chief engineer of the Chianan Irrigation System. statue: His statue sits on the ground in work clothes, chin on hand, thinking. wooden house: Four Japanese wooden houses recreate the engineers' village.

榻榻米：看看修復宿舍裡的榻榻米房間。 紀念：每年 5 月 8 日，人們聚在銅像前紀念他。

tatami: Look at the tatami rooms inside the restored houses. memorial: Every year on May 8, people gather at the statue to remember him.

實景照片

Photos on site

天壇 Temple of Heaven

烏山頭水庫園區裡的「天壇」：藍色琉璃瓦的三層圓頂、紅色柱子、白色石欄杆的圓形台基，外型仿照北京天壇的祈年殿，1973 年建成。

The Temple of Heaven in the reservoir park. It has a three-tiered round roof of blue tiles, red columns, and round white stone terraces. It is modelled on the Hall of Prayer in Beijing's Temple of Heaven, and was built in 1973.

八田宅 Hatta's house

八田與一紀念園區裡的日式宿舍：榻榻米房間、矮桌和坐墊，牆上掛著書法掛軸，前面擺著插花。左邊的木架上放著茶壺和茶杯。

Inside the Japanese-style house in the Hatta Yoichi memorial park. The tatami room has low tables and cushions, a calligraphy scroll on the wall, and flowers arranged below it. On the wooden shelves at the left are a teapot and cups.

日式房間 Japanese room

同一棟宿舍的另一個房間：紙糊的拉門、高處的格子窗和木頭天花板，是典型的日式房子。

Another room in the same house. Paper sliding doors, lattice windows up high, and a wooden ceiling: a typical Japanese house.
